title: MIDI-to-synth track converter
author: Elektron-MODS
description: Per-track MIDI<->synth converter for Digitone MK1 slots 4-7: MIDI+VOICE chord opens a YES/NO modal card (YES flips under interrupt mask, NO/timeout cancels, plain VOICE falls through, chord on 0-3 falls through); shared-trig flip keeps the live 976B pattern in place and swaps only the 326B synth sound (.bss) <-> 164B MIDI params + mute, first convert stages the kit slot-0 timbre (a zeroed record renders silence); HUD toast + LED feedback. S1/S2 dispatch interpose routes converted tracks to the stock synth fork (0-3 unchanged); F3 fetch interpose serves converted fires from mod .bss with voice-cache warm + per-track voice-flag/candidate-row stage. B0/B1/B2/B3/B4/B5/B6 browser interpose routes converted double-taps to the stock synth browser (bank-check divert + track>3 branch + mod-owned 808B session rows + open-gate switch-block skip + refresh-gate commit + apply-gate mirror) whose +16 points at the slot .bss sound, so preset-apply lands in .bss (kit untouched). V8 voice-menu bank divert routes converted plain-VOICE presses to the stock synth menu chain (bank-check divert at 0x4003f642; S3 0x4003df40/S4 0x40043258 proven not-on-path and left stock). L3 keyboard transpose-row divert draws converted slots with custom b1..b4 labels from mod .rodata (track divert at 0x400c28c2; S6 0x400bbd84/S7 0x40061ce4 proven not-on-converted-path and left stock). P1/P2 page divert routes converted param-page opens to the stock synth chain (view-track mirror-map at 0x40042240 + mod-owned 808B page row at 0x4004253c whose +16 points at the slot .bss sound, so draws read .bss and knob edits write .bss; P4 content divert forces the synth views table section at the entry-filler bank fork (moveq #3/cmp/bcs at 0x4003f184, d3 proven == track) for converted slots, so converted page keys open the synth views (SYN1/SYN2/FLTR/AMP as on native); C1 MAIN-page filler divert forces the synth views table section at the refresh-time filler bank fork (moveq #3/cmp/bcs at 0x4003db2c, d3 proven == ACTIVE on TRIG opens) for converted slots, so the converted MAIN page fills the synth views (S5 0x4003ca70 proven silent on TRIG opens and left stock); A1 MAIN value-resolver mirror maps the shared track->struct resolver track to the mirror slot (moveq #3/cmp/bcs at 0x4001d860, d1 proven == ACTIVE on TRIG opens; live d1->slot override flips converted knob values to the slot synth struct, S4B d0->0 override proven no-op and left stock) for converted slots, so converted MAIN-page knob values resolve from the slot synth struct as on native; P3 view-9 gate backs the v84 render gate (move.l d0/d2 + beq.w at 0x40042da8, verdict 9 proven native-only, caller-guarded); P5a/P5b param-edit sound divert returns the slot .bss sound from the row session +$28 virtuals (0x4002102a synth-editor + 0x400215d0 MIDI-editor) for converted slots, so knob edits write .bss; S8 0x40160968/S5 0x4003ca70 proven silent on page opens and left stock).
